Import a merged MetaPhlAn abundance table

Source: R/mp_import.R
mp_import_metaphlan.Rd

Parses the pipe-delimited lineage column of a merged MetaPhlAn3/4 table and builds a phyloseq object at the requested rank.

Usage

mp_import_metaphlan(path, metadata = NULL, level = "Species")

Arguments

path

Path to a merged MetaPhlAn table (tab-delimited; first column the clade lineage).

metadata

Optional sample metadata (path or data frame).

level

Taxonomic level to keep: one of "Kingdom", "Phylum", "Class", "Order", "Family", "Genus", "Species" (default).

Value

A phyloseq::phyloseq object.
